7th Grade · Unit 2 · Sports

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert holds a bow and aims at a target. He sends arrows towards its centre. His sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) archery

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert holds a bow and aims at a target. He sends arrows towards its centre.” Bu tarif “archery” kelimesine uyar; archery = okçuluk. Diğer şıklar: swimming (yüzme), boxing (boks), cycling (bisiklet sürme).

2

Ece watches two athletes on a mat. Each athlete tries to bring the other to the ground without punching. Their sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) wrestling

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece watches two athletes on a mat. Each athlete tries to bring the other to the ground without punching.” Bu tarif “wrestling” kelimesine uyar; wrestling = güreş. Diğer şıklar: football (futbol), gymnastics (jimnastik), diving (dalış).

3

Selin's team hits a ball over a high net. Players use their hands and do not let the ball touch their side of the floor. They play ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) volleyball

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin's team hits a ball over a high net. Players use their hands and do not let the ball touch their side of the floor.” Bu tarif “volleyball” kelimesine uyar; volleyball = voleybol. Diğer şıklar: fencing (eskrim), kickboxing (kick boks), table tennis (masa tenisi).

4

Bora watches two athletes in a ring. They wear large gloves and use only their fists to hit each other. Their sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) boxing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora watches two athletes in a ring. They wear large gloves and use only their fists to hit each other.” Bu tarif “boxing” kelimesine uyar; boxing = boks. Diğer şıklar: skating (paten), paragliding (yamaç paraşütü), skiing (kayak).

5

Duru watches players move across the ice. They use sticks to send a small puck into a goal. Their sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) ice hockey

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru watches players move across the ice. They use sticks to send a small puck into a goal.” Bu tarif “ice hockey” kelimesine uyar; ice hockey = buz hokeyi. Diğer şıklar: surfing (sörf), tennis (tenis), snowboarding (snowboard).

6

Arda trains with a heavy bar and metal weights. He lifts the bar above his head in competitions. His sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) weightlifting

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda trains with a heavy bar and metal weights. He lifts the bar above his head in competitions.” Bu tarif “weightlifting” kelimesine uyar; weightlifting = halter. Diğer şıklar: swimming (yüzme), archery (okçuluk), volleyball (voleybol).

7

Elif moves down a snowy slope. She wears two long narrow boards, one on each foot, and holds poles. Her sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) skiing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif moves down a snowy slope. She wears two long narrow boards, one on each foot, and holds poles.” Bu tarif “skiing” kelimesine uyar; skiing = kayak. Diğer şıklar: table tennis (masa tenisi), fencing (eskrim), skating (paten).

8

Can stands on a board in the sea. He rides a wave towards the beach without using a sail. His sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) surfing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can stands on a board in the sea. He rides a wave towards the beach without using a sail.” Bu tarif “surfing” kelimesine uyar; surfing = sörf. Diğer şıklar: ice hockey (buz hokeyi), cycling (bisiklet sürme), kickboxing (kick boks).

9

Nehir explores deep water with an air tank. She stays below the surface to look at sea life. Her activity is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) diving

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir explores deep water with an air tank. She stays below the surface to look at sea life.” Bu tarif “diving” kelimesine uyar; diving = dalış. Diğer şıklar: football (futbol), weightlifting (halter), paragliding (yamaç paraşütü).

10

Emir moves across the ice on boots with blades. He glides smoothly without a stick or a puck. His activity is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) skating

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir moves across the ice on boots with blades. He glides smoothly without a stick or a puck.” Bu tarif “skating” kelimesine uyar; skating = paten. Diğer şıklar: wrestling (güreş), tennis (tenis), gymnastics (jimnastik).

11

Sena puts on a helmet and gets on her bicycle. She pedals along a safe route in the park. Her activity is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) cycling

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena puts on a helmet and gets on her bicycle. She pedals along a safe route in the park.” Bu tarif “cycling” kelimesine uyar; cycling = bisiklet sürme. Diğer şıklar: kickboxing (kick boks), swimming (yüzme), surfing (sörf).

12

Baran starts from a high hill. A large fabric wing carries him through the air while he sits below it. His sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) paragliding

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran starts from a high hill. A large fabric wing carries him through the air while he sits below it.” Bu tarif “paragliding” kelimesine uyar; paragliding = yamaç paraşütü. Diğer şıklar: wrestling (güreş), table tennis (masa tenisi), weightlifting (halter).

13

İpek goes down a snowy slope. Both her feet are fixed to one wide board, and she does not use poles. Her sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) snowboarding

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek goes down a snowy slope. Both her feet are fixed to one wide board, and she does not use poles.” Bu tarif “snowboarding” kelimesine uyar; snowboarding = snowboard. Diğer şıklar: volleyball (voleybol), football (futbol), ice hockey (buz hokeyi).

14

Tolga wears a protective mask and a white suit. He uses a thin sporting sword to touch his opponent. His sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) fencing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga wears a protective mask and a white suit. He uses a thin sporting sword to touch his opponent.” Bu tarif “fencing” kelimesine uyar; fencing = eskrim. Diğer şıklar: archery (okçuluk), tennis (tenis), gymnastics (jimnastik).

15

Eylül and her friend use small bats and a light ball. They hit the ball across a small net on a table. They play ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) table tennis

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül and her friend use small bats and a light ball. They hit the ball across a small net on a table.” Bu tarif “table tennis” kelimesine uyar; table tennis = masa tenisi. Diğer şıklar: diving (dalış), snowboarding (snowboard), skiing (kayak).

16

Ozan trains in a ring with protective gloves. His sport allows him to use both punches and kicks. He does ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) kickboxing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan trains in a ring with protective gloves. His sport allows him to use both punches and kicks.” Bu tarif “kickboxing” kelimesine uyar; kickboxing = kick boks. Diğer şıklar: boxing (boks), fencing (eskrim), paragliding (yamaç paraşütü).

17

Cemre practises balances and difficult body movements. She performs routines on bars and a beam. Her sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) gymnastics

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre practises balances and difficult body movements. She performs routines on bars and a beam.” Bu tarif “gymnastics” kelimesine uyar; gymnastics = jimnastik. Diğer şıklar: skiing (kayak), surfing (sörf), wrestling (güreş).

18

Yusuf moves through a pool using his arms and legs. He races along a lane without using a board or an air tank. His sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) swimming

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf moves through a pool using his arms and legs. He races along a lane without using a board or an air tank.” Bu tarif “swimming” kelimesine uyar; swimming = yüzme. Diğer şıklar: diving (dalış), boxing (boks), skating (paten).

19

Melis uses a racket on a full-size court. She hits a ball over a net, and it can bounce once before she returns it. She plays ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) tennis

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis uses a racket on a full-size court. She hits a ball over a net, and it can bounce once before she returns it.” Bu tarif “tennis” kelimesine uyar; tennis = tenis. Diğer şıklar: snowboarding (snowboard), volleyball (voleybol), cycling (bisiklet sürme).

20

Aras plays in a team of eleven. Players usually use their feet to send a ball into the other team's goal. They play ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) football

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras plays in a team of eleven. Players usually use their feet to send a ball into the other team's goal.” Bu tarif “football” kelimesine uyar; football = futbol. Diğer şıklar: weightlifting (halter), ice hockey (buz hokeyi), archery (okçuluk).

21

Sıla practises archery after school. She holds a curved piece of equipment and pulls its string to send an arrow. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) bow

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla practises archery after school. She holds a curved piece of equipment and pulls its string to send an arrow.” Bu tarif “bow” kelimesine uyar; bow = yay. Diğer şıklar: stadium (stadyum), opponents (rakipler), tent (çadır).

22

Gökçe needs objects to shoot from her bow. They are long and narrow with pointed ends. They are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) arrows

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe needs objects to shoot from her bow. They are long and narrow with pointed ends.” Bu tarif “arrows” kelimesine uyar; arrows = oklar. Diğer şıklar: equipment (ekipman), archer (okçu), team (takım).

23

Defne aims at a board with coloured circles. She tries to hit its centre with an arrow. This board is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) target

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne aims at a board with coloured circles. She tries to hit its centre with an arrow.” Bu tarif “target” kelimesine uyar; target = hedef. Diğer şıklar: mat (minder), prize (ödül), wrestler (güreşçi).

24

Kerem plays tennis with a ball. He hits it with a handled frame that has tight strings. This object is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) racket

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem plays tennis with a ball. He hits it with a handled frame that has tight strings.” Bu tarif “racket” kelimesine uyar; racket = raket. Diğer şıklar: spectators (seyirciler), court (kort, saha), rules (kurallar).

25

Buse rides her bicycle safely. She wears a hard protective cover on her head. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) helmet

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse rides her bicycle safely. She wears a hard protective cover on her head.” Bu tarif “helmet” kelimesine uyar; helmet = kask. Diğer şıklar: finger tab (parmak koruyucu), pitch (saha), medal (madalya).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Deniz plays volleyball in a sports hall. A mesh barrier divides the two sides of the court. This barrier is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) net

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz plays volleyball in a sports hall. A mesh barrier divides the two sides of the court.” Bu tarif “net” kelimesine uyar; net = file. Diğer şıklar: team (takım), rules (kurallar), racket (raket).

2

İdil practises wrestling indoors. A thick soft surface covers the floor and helps protect the athletes. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) mat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil practises wrestling indoors. A thick soft surface covers the floor and helps protect the athletes.” Bu tarif “mat” kelimesine uyar; mat = minder. Diğer şıklar: equipment (ekipman), prize (ödül), pitch (saha).

3

Onur finishes first in a race. An official gives him a round metal award on a ribbon. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) medal

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur finishes first in a race. An official gives him a round metal award on a ribbon.” Bu tarif “medal” kelimesine uyar; medal = madalya. Diğer şıklar: stadium (stadyum), arrows (oklar), target (hedef).

4

Zeynep plays basketball with four other players on her side. They work together against another group. Her group is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) team

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep plays basketball with four other players on her side. They work together against another group.” Bu tarif “team” kelimesine uyar; team = takım. Diğer şıklar: archer (okçu), helmet (kask), tent (çadır).

5

Arda's side faces another side in a match. The players on that other side try to beat his group. They are his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) opponents

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda's side faces another side in a match. The players on that other side try to beat his group.” Bu tarif “opponents” kelimesine uyar; opponents = rakipler. Diğer şıklar: arm guard (kol koruyucu), spectators (seyirciler), bow (yay).

6

Mina goes to play tennis. The marked playing area has a net across the middle. It is a tennis ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) court

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina goes to play tennis. The marked playing area has a net across the middle.” Bu tarif “court” kelimesine uyar; court = kort, saha. Diğer şıklar: competition (yarışma), finger tab (parmak koruyucu), wrestler (güreşçi).

7

Ali's football team practises outdoors. Their large grass playing area has a goal at each end. It is a football ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) pitch

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali's football team practises outdoors. Their large grass playing area has a goal at each end.” Bu tarif “pitch” kelimesine uyar; pitch = saha. Diğer şıklar: equipment (ekipman), helmet (kask), mat (minder).

8

Pelin watches an important football match. Thousands of people sit in stands around the playing area. They are inside a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) stadium

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin watches an important football match. Thousands of people sit in stands around the playing area.” Bu tarif “stadium” kelimesine uyar; stadium = stadyum. Diğer şıklar: archer (okçu), finger tab (parmak koruyucu), bow (yay).

9

Efe enters an event with several other athletes. Each person tries to get the best result and win a prize. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) competition

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe enters an event with several other athletes. Each person tries to get the best result and win a prize.” Bu tarif “competition” kelimesine uyar; competition = yarışma. Diğer şıklar: arrows (oklar), medal (madalya), wrestler (güreşçi).

10

Derya wants to improve her sporting skills. She follows a planned programme of exercises with her coach. She needs to ______ regularly.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) train

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya wants to improve her sporting skills. She follows a planned programme of exercises with her coach.” Bu tarif “train” kelimesine uyar; train = antrenman yapmak. Diğer şıklar: beat (yenmek), lose (kaybetmek), play volleyball (voleybol oynamak).

11

Berk's basketball team needs more points. He aims at the basket and sends the ball through it. He tries to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) score

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk's basketball team needs more points. He aims at the basket and sends the ball through it.” Bu tarif “score” kelimesine uyar; score = sayı yapmak. Diğer şıklar: hit (vurmak), go hiking (doğa yürüyüşüne çıkmak), go cycling (bisiklete binmeye gitmek).

12

Sena's team finishes a match with two goals. The other team also has two goals, so neither side wins. The two teams ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) draw

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena's team finishes a match with two goals. The other team also has two goals, so neither side wins.” Bu tarif “draw” kelimesine uyar; draw = berabere kalmak. Diğer şıklar: serve (servis atmak), go camping (kampa gitmek), go skating (paten kaymaya gitmek).

13

Burak's team finishes the match with more goals than the other side. His team gets the victory. They ______ the match.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) win

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak's team finishes the match with more goals than the other side. His team gets the victory.” Bu tarif “win” kelimesine uyar; win = kazanmak. Diğer şıklar: go swimming (yüzmeye gitmek), wear (giymek), go fishing (balığa gitmek).

14

Eda's team finishes with fewer points than the other team. They do not get a draw or a victory. They ______ the match.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) lose

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda's team finishes with fewer points than the other team. They do not get a draw or a victory.” Bu tarif “lose” kelimesine uyar; lose = kaybetmek. Diğer şıklar: follow (uymak, takip etmek), wake up (uyanmak), get up (kalkmak).

15

Tuna's team has three goals, and the other team has only one. His side is the winner. They ______ their opponents.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) beat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna's team has three goals, and the other team has only one. His side is the winner.” Bu tarif “beat” kelimesine uyar; beat = yenmek. Diğer şıklar: carry (taşımak), press (basmak), score (sayı yapmak).

16

Cem runs slowly around the park for exercise. He does not race or run at full speed. He likes to ______ in the morning.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) go jogging

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem runs slowly around the park for exercise. He does not race or run at full speed.” Bu tarif “go jogging” kelimesine uyar; go jogging = koşuya çıkmak. Diğer şıklar: go swimming (yüzmeye gitmek), get up (kalkmak), wake up (uyanmak).

17

Aylin takes a tent and a sleeping bag into the countryside. She sleeps outdoors instead of staying in a hotel. She likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) go camping

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin takes a tent and a sleeping bag into the countryside. She sleeps outdoors instead of staying in a hotel.” Bu tarif “go camping” kelimesine uyar; go camping = kampa gitmek. Diğer şıklar: go skating (paten kaymaya gitmek), win (kazanmak), play volleyball (voleybol oynamak).

18

Eren takes a rod and some bait to a lake. He waits beside the water and tries to catch fish. He likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) go fishing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren takes a rod and some bait to a lake. He waits beside the water and tries to catch fish.” Bu tarif “go fishing” kelimesine uyar; go fishing = balığa gitmek. Diğer şıklar: carry (taşımak), go jogging (koşuya çıkmak), serve (servis atmak).

19

Nehir puts on walking boots and follows a mountain path. She enjoys long walks in natural places without running. She likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) go hiking

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir puts on walking boots and follows a mountain path. She enjoys long walks in natural places without running.” Bu tarif “go hiking” kelimesine uyar; go hiking = doğa yürüyüşüne çıkmak. Diğer şıklar: follow (uymak, takip etmek), hit (vurmak), train (antrenman yapmak).

20

Baran goes to tennis practice on Tuesdays and Fridays only. These are his two practice days each week. He trains ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) twice a week

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran goes to tennis practice on Tuesdays and Fridays only. These are his two practice days each week.” Bu tarif “twice a week” kelimesine uyar; twice a week = haftada iki kez. Diğer şıklar: never (asla, hiçbir zaman), sometimes (bazen), on weekdays (hafta içi).

21

İpek swims on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays only. She has three swimming sessions in each week. She swims ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) three times a week

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek swims on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays only. She has three swimming sessions in each week.” Bu tarif “three times a week” kelimesine uyar; three times a week = haftada üç kez. Diğer şıklar: on Sundays (pazar günleri), at the weekends (hafta sonları), twice a month (ayda iki kez).

22

Tolga joins a long cycling trip on the first Sunday of each month. He has no other cycling trips that month. He joins this trip ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) once a month

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga joins a long cycling trip on the first Sunday of each month. He has no other cycling trips that month.” Bu tarif “once a month” kelimesine uyar; once a month = ayda bir kez. Diğer şıklar: once a day (günde bir kez), sometimes (bazen), on weekdays (hafta içi).

23

Eylül does stretching exercises from Monday to Sunday. She does not miss a single day of the week. She stretches ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) every day

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül does stretching exercises from Monday to Sunday. She does not miss a single day of the week.” Bu tarif “every day” kelimesine uyar; every day = her gün. Diğer şıklar: never (asla, hiçbir zaman), twice a week (haftada iki kez), twice a month (ayda iki kez).

24

Ozan finds a race very difficult. His friend encourages him not to give up before the finish. His friend says that he should not ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) throw in the towel

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan finds a race very difficult. His friend encourages him not to give up before the finish.” Bu tarif “throw in the towel” kelimesine uyar; throw in the towel = pes etmek. Diğer şıklar: be afraid of (-den korkmak), eat junk food (abur cubur yemek), eat healthy food (sağlıklı beslenmek).

25

Cemre wants advice before a difficult competition. Her coach tells her to try as hard as she can, whatever the result. The coach says, "You should ______."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) give your best shot

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre wants advice before a difficult competition. Her coach tells her to try as hard as she can, whatever the result.” Bu tarif “give your best shot” kelimesine uyar; give your best shot = elinden gelenin en iyisini yapmak. Diğer şıklar: break rules (kuralları çiğnemek), be interested in (-ile ilgilenmek), go on a diet (diyete başlamak).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

archery

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) okçuluk

“archery” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “okçuluk” olur. Bu ifade “Spor dalları” grubundandır. Örnek: Archery needs a bow and arrows.

2

wrestling

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) güreş

“wrestling” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “güreş” olur. Bu ifade “Spor dalları” grubundandır. Örnek: Wrestling is a traditional sport in Türkiye.

3

volleyball

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) voleybol

“volleyball” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “voleybol” olur. Bu ifade “Spor dalları” grubundandır. Örnek: We play volleyball at school.

4

boxing

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) boks

“boxing” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “boks” olur. Bu ifade “Spor dalları” grubundandır. Örnek: Boxers wear gloves in boxing.

5

ice hockey

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) buz hokeyi

“ice hockey” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “buz hokeyi” olur. Bu ifade “Spor dalları” grubundandır. Örnek: Ice hockey players skate on ice.

6

weightlifting

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) halter

“weightlifting” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “halter” olur. Bu ifade “Spor dalları” grubundandır. Örnek: He lifts heavy weights in weightlifting.
